briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.1%, S&P500 +0.1%), so we held back from aggressively deploying the open slots. TEX stood out with every bullish technical signal confirmed at once, so we took one high-conviction position while leaving two slots open for a stronger risk-on day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting until several technical signals agree — like a bullish MACD crossover, RSI sitting in the healthy 55-70 range, price trading above its 20-day moving average, and a volume surge — before buying. Any single signal can be a false alarm, but when they all line up together it suggests real institutional buying interest, giving more confidence in the trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指等待多個技術訊號同時出現一致訊息才進場，例如MACD出現黃金交叉、RSI處於55至70的健康區間、股價站上20日均線，以及成交量放大。單一訊號可能只是假訊號，但當這些條件同時成立時，往往代表有真正的機構資金進場買進，讓交易決策更有信心。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were roughly unchanged today, with the NASDAQ down 0.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.1%, indicating a lack of strong directional conviction among investors. No major catalysts drove broad market moves, leaving stock selection focused on individual company technicals rather than macro themes. In this environment, selective stock-picking based on confirmed momentum signals outperforms broad index-following.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢近乎持平，納斯達克指數微跌0.1%，標普500指數則小幅上揚0.1%，反映投資人缺乏明確方向感。市場並無重大消息面催化，個股表現主要取決於個別公司的技術面而非宏觀題材。在這種環境下，依據確認的動能訊號精選個股，比單純追蹤大盤指數更具優勢。

trades.reasoning: Full signal confirmation (MACD bullish crossover, rising histogram, RSI 63 in the healthy 55-70 zone, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge) marks genuine institutional buying, not just a neutral-day reach for yield.
